items.title: Role of AI, Apps, and Digital Services in Business (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Role of AI, Apps, and Digital Services in Business (PDF 134, printed 130).

blocks.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile apps aur digital services jadeed karobar ki taraqqi mein aham kirdar ada karte hain. AI entrepreneurs ko data parakhne, customers ka rawaiya samajhne aur behtar faisle karne mein madad deta hai. Mobile apps karobar ke liye customers tak pohanchna, products bechna aur services jaldi dena aasan banati hain. Online payments, cloud storage aur marketing tools jaisi digital services karkardagi barhati aur kharche kam karti hain. Mil kar yeh technologies innovation ki madad karti hain aur digital economy mein karobar ko zyada muqable ke qabil banati hain.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: AI tools ab design kar sakte, likh sakte aur karobar chalane mein madad bhi kar sakte hain.

blocks.caption: Business mein kis ka kya kirdar
rows: Data analysis, gahak ka rawaiya samajhna, behtar faisle
Gahakon tak pohanch, bechna, services tezi se
Online payments, cloud storage, marketing tools: efficiency aur kam kharch

blocks.prompt: AI, mobile apps aur digital services business mein alag alag kya kaam karti hain?
blocks.explanation: AI data analyze kar ke gahak ka rawaiya samajhti aur faisle behtar banati hai; mobile apps gahakon tak pohanchne aur bechne mein madad karti hain; digital services (online payments, cloud storage, marketing tools) efficiency barhati aur kharch kam karti hain.

items: AI, apps aur digital services karobar ko zyada competitive banate hain.
